items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against cancellation of Kindergeld
items.quote: Einzulegen ist er innerhalb eines Monats seit der Bekanntgabe – schriftlich, elektronisch oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter is dated (and treated as posted) 27.08.2027 (Friday); no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the printed date is the posting day. Familienkasse decisions follow the tax-law Bekanntgabefiktion (§122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO analog, §108 Abs.3 AO): delivery = 4th calendar day after posting, counting from the day after posting (day of posting not counted). 28 Aug = day1 (Sat), 29 Aug = day2 (Sun), 30 Aug = day3 (Mon), 31 Aug = day4 (Tue) -> deemed delivery 31.08.2027. 31 Aug is a Tuesday, not a weekend/holiday, so no shift of the delivery day is needed. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO) then runs under §188 Abs.2 BGB: it ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day (31). September has only 30 days, so under §188 Abs.3 BGB the period ends on the last day of September, i.e. 30.09.2027 (a Thursday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed).
